lead.headline: Colom beats Hyde-Smith in Mississippi for Democrats' eighth Senate flip
lead.dek: The AP called the race Wednesday after days of absentee and provisional counting; Colom is the state's first Black senator since Reconstruction
body: Democrat Scott Colom, a 43-year-old district attorney, defeated Republican Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith in Mississippi on Wednesday after local officials spent several days processing absentee and provisional ballots, the Associated Press and CBS News projected; a few dozen votes separated them the day after the election.

Colom will be Mississippi's first Black senator since Reconstruction and the first Democrat the state has sent to the Senate since 1982; the last Democrat elected to this seat, in 1947, was a segregationist. Trump carried the state by about 20 points in 2024, and national Democrats began spending on the race only last month, after the Cook Political Report moved it to lean Republican.

Hyde-Smith, 67, appointed in 2018 and twice elected over Mike Espy, conceded in a video message Wednesday night, saying she respected the voters' decision. The seat is Democrats' eighth flip after North Carolina, South Carolina, Texas, Ohio, Iowa, Kansas and Maine, giving them at least 55 seats in January with Alaska still undecided, per CBS.

briefs.headline: Nvidia board met late Wednesday on ousting Huang, Reuters reports
briefs.summary: A source told Reuters the 11-member board met to decide the CEO's future after the Wall Street Journal reported it was preparing to fire him; shares fell more than 8% after hours, about $600B in value lost since the board's probe began.

briefs.headline: Bessent moves to a military base after Iranian threats, Treasury says
briefs.summary: A Treasury spokesperson said the secretary left his Georgetown home after a series of threats on his life, first reported by the New York Times; a source told CBS a published photo let someone geolocate the house. The base was not named.

briefs.headline: Brooklyn building collapses into a construction site, killing 2
briefs.summary: A three-storey mixed-use building at Bedford and Flatbush avenues fell into an open excavation about 4 p.m. Wednesday, trapping residents and workers; four victims were critical and 12 stable, and Mayor Zohran Mamdani said crews arrived within a minute.

briefs.headline: White House counsel warns incoming Oversight chair that probes could be crimes
briefs.summary: Will Scharf's letter to Rep. Robert Garcia said subpoenas without a 'legitimate legislative purpose' could prompt executive-branch investigations; Garcia said Congress's power comes from Article I, and Trump posted that Democrats 'should go to jail.'

briefs.headline: Russia and Ukraine agree a large prisoner swap as Abu Dhabi talks end
briefs.summary: Two days of U.S.-mediated talks, the first in nine months, produced no settlement; Jared Kushner said numbers would be finalized Thursday and a Russian official said the exchange could come within two to three weeks.

briefs.headline: Indonesia's vice president resigns over a disputed high school diploma
briefs.summary: Gibran Rakabuming Raka, 39, son of former President Joko Widodo, quit Thursday after courts ruled in October that his education documents failed election rules and 120 lawmakers began an impeachment process; the assembly has 60 days to pick a successor.

briefs.headline: Israeli strike on Nasser Hospital's surgery wing kills 6 in Khan Younis
briefs.summary: Gaza's Health Ministry said a doctor was among the dead and at least a dozen were wounded early Thursday; the Israeli military said it struck a senior Hamas figure operating inside the hospital, offering no evidence.

briefs.headline: Pope Leo XIV lands in Lima and calls Peru his homeland
briefs.summary: The first pope with Peruvian citizenship arrived Wednesday for the final leg of a 12-day South American tour, greeted by President Keiko Fujimori; he spent more than 20 years in the country, including as bishop of Chiclayo, and will say Mass in Pucallpa and Cusco.

briefs.headline: Democrats ask Hanshaw and Smith to seek AG opinion on Hunt's tax deeds
briefs.summary: The memo asks whether Auditor Mark Hunt had authority to sign nine delinquent-property deeds past the statutory deadline, without court orders, to a company tied to an associate; the Senate president's office said it is evaluating the request.

briefs.headline: State Police tell lawmakers sextortion complaints are up 630% since 2024
briefs.summary: Sgt. Rachel Blankenship told the Joint Judiciary Committee Tuesday that CyberTipline complaints rose from 86 in 2024 to more than 628 this year; the agency asked for about $2.3M to grow its child-abuse investigations unit from 15 officers to 28.

briefs.headline: U.S. attorneys form a statewide fraud and diversion task force
briefs.summary: Moore Capito and Matthew Harvey's task force joins the FBI, IRS, HSI, the attorney general, the auditor and the insurance commission on benefits, tax and securities fraud; Harvey said on Talkline that fraud takes more than $630M a day from federal programs.

briefs.headline: Kessel fire on Cacapon Mountain reaches 260 acres, 60% contained
briefs.summary: The fire that began Monday inside Cacapon Resort State Park in Morgan County is being fought by the Division of Forestry, DNR, volunteer departments and crews from Maryland and Pennsylvania, with National Guard Blackhawks dropping water drawn from the park's lake.

regional.item: Downtown Huntington's historic core, the Marshall IDEA District and Westmoreland are among 52 Opportunity Zones certified statewide, effective Jan. 1.
Someone cut the wiring of Winfield United Methodist's walk-through Christmas light display; volunteers are repairing it to open after Thanksgiving.
The DAR's Blennerhassett Chapter opened a free founding-fathers and veterans exhibit at the Parkersburg Welcome Center Wednesday, running through Jan. 5.

away.item: A state snowplow the Village School's pre-K class named Stormin' Normin, for the village highway superintendent, visited the school Tuesday.

hotspots.item: Webster County's superintendent told the school board Oct. 26 that its records building is failing, filing cabinets leaning, and floated digitizing or replacing it.
Jason Jordan was sworn in Monday to the Pender County school board's District 2 seat, which Beth Burns left for the county commission; he ran unopposed Nov. 3.

briefs.headline: SD57's seven trustees take office and elect Sarah Holland chair
briefs.summary: Judge D. Simpkin swore in Holland, Jake Skakun, Shar McCrory, Don Sabo, Erica McLean, Tianna Klein and Bob Thompson at Tuesday's inaugural meeting in Prince George; McLean stays vice-chair and the board next meets in public Jan. 12.

briefs.headline: Pemberton orders evacuations as 214 mm of rain swamps the South Coast
briefs.summary: The River Forecast Centre raised flood warnings for the Pemberton Valley, Howe Sound, Sea to Sky and the North Shore Wednesday as Port Mellon logged 214 mm in 24 hours; Pemberton cleared Airport Road, including its airport and sewage plant.

briefs.headline: Carney takes Canada's EU 'associate' bid to a 50-leader summit in Dublin
briefs.summary: The prime minister is the only non-European addressing Thursday's European Political Community meeting, where Zelensky briefs leaders on the Abu Dhabi talks; Carney flies on to ASEAN in Manila, the Francophonie in Phnom Penh and APEC in Shenzhen.

briefs.headline: Pilot dies as a Remembrance Day flypast plane crashes in Quebec's Beauce
briefs.summary: The man in his 60s, alone aboard, went down in woods near the Saint-Georges airport about 11 a.m. Wednesday while landing after a ceremony flight with other small planes; the Transportation Safety Board is on scene and the cause is not known.

briefs.headline: Hera begins its 'crash site investigation' of the asteroid DART struck
briefs.summary: ESA's car-sized probe is studying Didymos and its moonlet Dimorphos from 25 to 30 km away and moves in to about 20 km next month; NASA's 2022 impact shortened the 151-metre moonlet's orbit and threw a debris trail more than 10,000 km long.

briefs.headline: Radio pulses every 8 minutes come from a white dwarf circling a Sun-like star
briefs.summary: ICRAR's team found GPM J071507-114153, more than 5,000 light-years away, with the Murchison Widefield Array, located it with MeerKAT and confirmed the G-type companion at Keck; it is the first long-period transient found with a Sun-like partner.

briefs.headline: Microplastics found in 43 of 47 tapirs and anteaters, even 65 km from roads
briefs.summary: Blood from GPS-collared animals across Brazil's Amazon, Cerrado and Pantanal carried more particles where ranges overlapped intensive human use or waste facilities, UBC and HZDR report in Nature; every Pantanal animal tested positive.

briefs.headline: Irregular sleep tracks with worse depression in 23,000 ring wearers, UCSF finds
briefs.summary: Over an average 154 days of smart-ring data, people with severe depression symptoms scored 75 on a 100-point sleep regularity index against 84 for those with few; the Scientific Reports study is observational and partly funded by Oura.

briefs.headline: DeepMind agents prove Signal's handshake and ratchet secure in four weeks
briefs.summary: AlphaProof Code's Gemini Carbon agents wrote 6.5 million lines of Lean to verify libsignal's PQXDH handshake and Triple Ratchet against a human-written specification, work that usually takes years; the result assumes perfect cryptography.

briefs.headline: OpenAI builds a 'Control Room' that can halt research models in 35 seconds
briefs.summary: The system, announced Tuesday, tracks workloads across OpenAI's research infrastructure and cuts a model's output about 35 seconds after a shutdown decision, a delay the company says it is driving to zero; it did not say why it built the switch now.

briefs.headline: Grok-built web apps exposed ICU lab values and 3,500 hospital staff names
briefs.summary: Security firm Claroc found 94.7% of 37,571 live apps open without a login and 650 to 800 holding private data, including 24 from SpaceXSI and X employees; the company took those 24 down and said apps are private until shared.

weather_ear: Thursday's forecast comes from Jim Claudtore at 7:15.
kicker: Nicholas-Webster and Summers-New River carry no regional line today; Kushner and Witkoff meet Putin in Moscow before joining Zelensky in Dublin.

art.caption: The collapsed building on Flatbush Avenue from above: front wall gone, floor slabs open to the air, rubble sloping into the pit next door.
